What are the request limits on each plan?
What happens if I go over my limit?
Requests over the limit return a rate-limit error (429) and are not billed. Upgrade anytime to raise your limits.
What payment methods do you accept for plan subscriptions?
Can I change my plan later if I want to upgrade or downgrade?
What happens when I run out of credits?
Turn on Recharge when low and we add $10 in credits when your balance drops under 1,000. You can also add credits anytime from your account.
